items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: I was talking to Bunny Berigan when I was about 18 or 19... and he gave me a long lecture about it.

ctx.x: In that kind of environment it turns out that way. I think that Zoot(Sims) is about as black as anybody I know.
Yeah, I guess so. Because, you know, it's more comfortable for me to think it's cultural because if it's inherited, I don't have a chance. But there was this undercurrent.

Now, when I went to Hollywood, they had all these places, these clubs, guys used to go around to different clubs and sit in and play. Now, many times -- many times, maybe four or five times, I would get the comment, look, if you want to play like a nigger, you can't play here. Why don't you go down to Central Avenue? Well, they didn't particularly want me at Central Avenue, either, because they had plenty of good players of their own. But that was the kind of stuff you would go through.
